# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the EXACT tasks you broke/fixed) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 (first optimizer step off seed) — verification checklist + type-preservation + leave-untouched
- Changes I made:
  - task_template.md (STRUCTURE): rewrote the soft 3-step loop into an ordered procedure + a MANDATORY pre-finish checklist ("an output file existing is NOT success"). Targets premature-Done cluster (55457, 347-49) and adds the key item: "reproduce the instruction's concrete worked example, then generalize the pattern" → targets 347-49 delete-block logic.
  - prompt.md + checklist (CONTRACT/KNOWLEDGE): preserve source cell TYPE — numbers as numbers (not "208.88"), int-valued numbers as int (pandas floats int cols with NaN → 123.0), and keep text/date-like text/leading-zero labels ("01") as text, never coerce. Targets 418-29 (float-where-int, its only diff) and 347-49 (str/int-where-float).
  - prompt.md + checklist (CONTRACT): only produce the cells the instruction asks for; leave other in-range cells at original value/blank; never pad with 0/defaults. Targets 52216 (flaky overwrite of an original cell) and the padding seen in 55457.
- Expected effect + safety: 347-49 0→~1.0 (example forces whole-block delete), 418-29 0.22→~0.33+ (int cast), 52216 0.78→~1.0 (no spurious overwrite). SAFE: checklist is a gate (passing tasks already satisfy it); type rule's "keep text as text" clause is exactly what protects 47484 ("01" text), 40467 (text label), 160-6 (date-like text) — verified by reading their passing traces.
- Building on prior RESULTS / refuted (from persistent memory of earlier runs): did NOT re-try "write Excel FORMULA instead of literal" (regressed 52216/53161 — all-or-nothing on recalc); did NOT re-try "write real dates not string forms" (broke 160-6) — my type rule does the OPPOSITE and FORBIDS date coercion. Kept "prefer literals".
- High-value clusters still not cracked: 347-49 fix is plausible but not certain (relies on gpt-5-mini deriving whole-block deletion from the example) — if rejected, next lever is a KNOWLEDGE line stating the separator-block deletion pattern explicitly (blank rows + adjacent label/header rows anchored on the search text), scoped so 160-6's pure-blank-row delete is unaffected.
- Data defects handed back (NOT prompt-fixable, do not burn future iterations on them): 55457 EMPTY instruction; 32468 corrupted gold; 374-9 capped ~1/3 by double-count gold defect.
- Focus next iteration: if accepted, push 374-9 variant-1 consistency and confirm 347-49; if rejected, read broke={} and drop the offending edit only.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.522 Δ=+0.011 · fixed={52216} · broke={53161}.
<!-- cand_0001: ACCEPTED val=0.522 Δ=+0.011 -->

## Iteration cand_0002 (off cand_0001) — 4 additive knowledge rules across 4 distinct clusters
- Changes I made (1 line/edit):
  - task_template.md (KNOWLEDGE, cluster 347-49): sharpened the worked-example checklist item — when the example conflicts with the prose ("blank rows" vs a span "29 to 36" that covers a label/header row), the example is authoritative; act on the FULL stated span.
  - prompt.md (KNOWLEDGE/CONTRACT, cluster 418-29): answer_position bounds WRITING, not READING — for match/sum/dedup/lookup/search the SOURCE rows may extend beyond it; find the real data extent and process all source rows.
  - prompt.md (KNOWLEDGE, cluster 53161): align output-grid values to in-sheet labels/headers, not a fixed index offset (source-item count ≠ output-row count).
  - prompt.md (KNOWLEDGE/method, cluster 374-9 recoverable): read cached COMPUTED values (data_only=True / pandas); a formula read without it is a string and gets skipped by numeric filters → sums too low.
- Expected effect + safety: 347-49 0→~0.67 (reproduce full separator-block span); 418-29 0.33→~1.0 (net duplicates below the range on v2/v3); 53161 0.67→~1.0 (label alignment removes the one-row shift); 374-9 steadied at its ~0.33 ceiling (data_only keeps col-H subtotal in the sum). All 4 are ADDITIVE/BOUNDED knowledge the agent lacked, none loosens a global rule, none pushes toward "fill the range" or type coercion (the known regressors), so 47484/40467/52216/160-6 are unaffected.
- Building on prior RESULTS: kept ALL of cand_0001's accepted edits (type-preservation, don't-pad, pre-finish checklist) intact — only ADDED to them. Did NOT re-try the refuted "write Excel FORMULA not literal" (regressed 52216/53161) or "write real dates not strings" (broke 160-6).
- Refuted hypotheses (proven false THIS iteration by reading traces — do not re-test): (a) prior memory that 418-29's failure is "col-A reference numbers written as float where int expected" — FALSE; col A is int in agent output and gold across all variants; the real cause is unsubtracted col-B duplicate rows located BELOW answer_position. (b) prior claim that 32468 has "corrupted gold" — UNSUPPORTED; instruction is coherent (SUMIFS 12-month window), failure is a value-only disagreement.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 32468 (value-only SUMIFS window disagreement; correct window length/sign not derivable from traces — needs gold values before any prompt rule can be verified). 55457 unwinnable (empty instruction). 374-9 capped 1/3 (gold doubles top-8 rows only).
- Plateau signal: none yet (only 1 prior accepted step). If this batch is rejected, read broke={} and drop only the offending edit — the four are independent, so a single regression need not sink the others.
- Focus next iteration: if accepted, inspect 32468's gold values directly (ground-truth data location) to determine the exact 12-month window/sign, then add a NARROWED window rule; otherwise triage the broke set.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.533 Δ=+0.011 · fixed={—} · broke={47484}.
<!-- cand_0002: ACCEPTED val=0.533 Δ=+0.011 -->

<!-- cap-evolve:journal-append-below — add your Iteration entry under this line; do not edit anything above it -->

## Iteration cand_0003 (off cand_0002) — 3 additive rules for the 3 recoverable flaky clusters + 2 checklist gates
- Changes I made (1 line/edit; file + cluster):
  - prompt.md (KNOWLEDGE, new rule, cluster 418-29 / reinforces 347-49): DELETE/REMOVE rows ⇒ Excel shift-up compaction — write survivors contiguously from the top, blank the freed bottom rows, never clear in place / leave stale trailing rows. Explicit scoped exception to "leave cells as they were".
  - prompt.md (CONTRACT narrowing, cluster 53161): clarified the absolute "never pad with 0" bullet — it forbids inventing values for UNDEFINED cells but does NOT permit leaving a COMPUTED cell blank; a legitimately-computed 0 in a fully-defined grid is written as literal 0; match a worked example grid's fill density.
  - prompt.md (KNOWLEDGE interpretation, cluster 47484): sequential/running number keyed on column(s) ⇒ count OCCURRENCES within each key group in row order (restart per key), NOT one number per distinct key.
  - task_template.md (STRUCTURE, 2 pre-finish checklist items): (a) after a deletion, survivors contiguous at top + freed rows blank + no gap/stale row; (b) no computed grid cell left blank, computed 0 written as 0.
- Per change, EXPECTED effect + why safe:
  - 418-29 0.67→~1.0: failing trial cleared duplicates in place (gaps at r3/r5, stale r6/r7); gold compacts (VERIFIED V1 survivors r1-r5, r6-r7 blank). Safe — reinforces passing 160-6 (gold VERIFIED compacts r6-r8 filled/r9-r11 blank); no non-deletion task touched.
  - 53161 0.67→~1.0: failing trial left 34 computed-0 cells blank (`if any_found`); gold fills all 208 incl. literal 0 (VERIFIED). Safe — 52216 gold fills all 10 lookup cells (VERIFIED, no intentional blanks); 160-6 trailing cells are UNDEFINED so still blank.
  - 47484 0.67→~1.0: failing trial numbered per DISTINCT key; gold = per-occurrence running count (VERIFIED all 3 variants). Safe — no passing task does group numbering. NB: 47484 is NOT a type failure — scorer coerces numeric strings (round(float(v),2)) so str "01"==int 1; the memory "gold = leading-zero strings" is WRONG (gold is int).
- Building on prior RESULTS: kept ALL cand_0001+cand_0002 accepted edits intact (type-preserve, don't-pad, read-extent, label-align, data_only, worked-example-authoritative, checklist) — only ADDED/clarified around them. Did NOT re-try refuted "write Excel FORMULA not literal" (regressed 52216/53161) or "write real dates not strings" (broke 160-6).
- Refuted hypotheses proven THIS iteration (never re-test): (a) 47484 gold is leading-zero TEXT — FALSE, gold is int; scorer coerces numeric strings so type is irrelevant here; the failure is a value/interpretation error (per-distinct-key vs per-occurrence). (b) 53161's 34 empty cells are a padding issue — actually the OPPOSITE: gold REQUIRES the computed 0s; the absolute anti-pad rule caused the miss.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 347-49 (0.33) — t1/t2 delete too few rows (stop at the non-blank "Employee Info" label); worked-example-authoritative rule already targets it and it's a reasoning-variance gap, not a knowledge gap — more prose = bloat. Next lever if still stuck: a worked in-context EXAMPLE showing block-deletion anchored on the search text (structural), scoped so 160-6's pure-blank delete is unaffected.
- Refuted/unwinnable data defects (do NOT burn iterations): 55457 (empty instruction), 32468 (corrupted gold — mutated DISCOUNT cell), 374-9 (double-count gold defect, ceiling 1/3).
- Plateau signal: 2 accepted steps of +0.011 each; this batch targets 3 independent flaky tasks at once (~+0.10 if all land) — a breadth push rather than one deep fix. If rejected, the 3 rules are independent: read broke={} / per-task means and drop only the offending one.
- Focus next iteration: if accepted, attack 347-49 with a structural block-deletion example; otherwise triage the broke set. All prompt-fixable value clusters other than 347-49 will then be addressed; remaining misses are the 3 confirmed data defects.
